description: This file implements the native interface for the Android Choreographer, providing functions to manage frame callbacks, refresh rate callbacks, and access to frame timing data. It includes functions for creating, destroying, and interacting with Choreographer instances, and contains inline functions for casting between native and API types.

classes.name: AChoreographer
classes.description: Opaque handle representing the native Choreographer object used in the C API.

methods.name: AChoreographer_signalRefreshRateCallbacks
methods.description: Signals refresh rate callbacks with the given vsync period.

methods.name: AChoreographer_initJVM
methods.description: Initializes the JVM environment for the Choreographer.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routeGetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Choreographer.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routePostFrameCallback
methods.description: Posts a frame callback to the Choreographer.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routePostFrameCallbackDelayed
methods.description: Posts a delayed frame callback.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routePostFrameCallback64
methods.description: Posts a 64-bit timestamp frame callback.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routePostFrameCallbackDelayed64
methods.description: Posts a delayed 64-bit timestamp frame callback.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routePostVsyncCallback
methods.description: Posts a Vsync callback.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routeRegisterRefreshRateCallback
methods.description: Registers a refresh rate callback.

methods.name: AChoreographer_routeUnregisterRefreshRateCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a refresh rate callback.

methods.name: AChoreographerFrameCallbackData_routeGetFrameTimeNanos
methods.description: Retrieves the frame time in nanoseconds from callback data.

methods.name: AChoreographerFrameCallbackData_routeGetFrameTimelinesLength
methods.description: Gets the number of frame timelines.

methods.name: AChoreographerFrameCallbackData_routeGetPreferredFrameTimelineIndex
methods.description: Gets the preferred frame timeline index.

methods.name: AChoreographerFrameCallbackData_routeGetFrameTimelineVsyncId
methods.description: Gets the vsync ID for a specific frame timeline.

methods.name: AChoreographerFrameCallbackData_routeGetFrameTimelineExpectedPresentationTimeNanos
methods.description: Gets the expected presentation time in nanoseconds for a frame timeline.

methods.name: AChoreographerFrameCallbackData_routeGetFrameTimelineDeadlineNanos
methods.description: Gets the deadline timestamp in nanoseconds for a frame timeline.

methods.name: AChoreographer_create
methods.description: Creates a new Choreographer instance.

methods.name: AChoreographer_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a Choreographer instance.

methods.name: AChoreographer_getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the Choreographer.

methods.name: AChoreographer_handlePendingEvents
methods.description: Handles pending events for the Choreographer.
